evidence.quote: Backed by an AI-powered LLM, the AI assistant provides feedback and guidance to students

ai_features.note: Core similarity checking is not generative AI. Generative AI is in the Clarity AI assistant, an add-on, and grammar and citation checkers.

evidence.quote: Claude Haiku 4.5
Amazon Nova 2 Lite
Turnitin - in-house

ai_providers.note: Anthropic models are used for the first-pass feedback and Clarity AI assistant. Amazon Nova powers the grammar checker. Other items on the trust-centre AI list are in-house.

evidence.quote: Limited student writing may be used to train this classifier model, after running the writing through processes designed to remove personal data.
We use limited student assignment data to evaluate, improve, and extend the quality of the Turnitin AI assistant responses

trains_on_content.note: Writing trains the AI-writing classifier only for institutions with Originality AI detection enabled. Pre-trained LLM providers are stated not to train on it. The vendor says it does not train generative or LLM models.

ai_zero_retention.note: Trust centre says the pre-trained LLMs do not use or retain student data for AI training. That is narrower than a zero-retention statement for logs, which was not found.

evidence.quote: it can be disabled from the administrator account settings page

ai_admin_off.note: Applies to AI writing detection. Clarity AI assistance can be turned off by individual instructors.

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement found. The trust centre has a general AI transparency list ("Transparency is a critical part of our AI principles"), which does not mention the AI Act.

certifications.note: DPA annex II.12 says Turnitin is SOC2 certified by AICPA. Type 1 or Type 2 is not stated. No ISO certificate found on pages checked.
